_comment: MLIE_FAUNA_ABSORPTION_1 Wave B. old Mlie defName -> new RSW_ defName. Sibling to mlie_creature_defname_map_wave_a.json (Bantha) and mlie_sound_defname_map.json (589 SoundDefs). Covers this wave's 6 creatures (Dewback, Wampa, Acklay, Vulptex, Porg, Nuna) plus every supporting def (BodyDef, BodyPartDef/GroupDef, AbilityDef/HediffDef/TrainableDef, resource ThingDef) their ports needed. Wampa and Acklay were Tier C (no functional dependency, never actually cast) before this wave - wired in per the owner's question-card ruling (STARWARS_DONOR_SUNSET_1, 2026-09-02). Nuna's defName collision with vanilla Core is resolved by this same RSW_ prefix - both now coexist in the cast.

bodyparts_full_file_port._comment: The WHOLE donor BodyParts_StarWars.xml was ported (not just this wave's needs) - future waves reusing these tail/claw/horn/wing/tentacle parts need no repeat of this exercise.

not_ported_this_wave._comment: Reek, Tauntaun, Nexu - named in this item's original Wave B plan (2026-09-02) - were re-verified against the LIVE BiomeCast_Ashkarr.xml this pass and found ABSENT from the current cast entirely (dropped in a later biome-authoring session; the 2026-09-02 census was stale). Not ported: no longer a measured dependency. A future wave should re-run the full non-scan-grade defName sweep (this item's own Wave C precondition) before deciding whether they need porting at all.
not_ported_this_wave.Reek: not currently cast, no cast_assignment.csv row - deferred pending re-verification
not_ported_this_wave.Tauntaun: not currently cast, no cast_assignment.csv row - deferred pending re-verification
not_ported_this_wave.Nexu: not currently cast, no cast_assignment.csv row - deferred pending re-verification

known_gap_found_and_fixed_this_pass._comment: Wave A's RSW_Bantha (2026-09-02) was authored but its 3 BiomeCast_Ashkarr.xml cast entries and 3 cast_assignment.csv rows were NEVER repointed from bare 'Bantha' - meaning the wild Bantha population was still Mlie's donor def, not our own port, until this pass. Fixed here alongside Wave B's own renames (same mechanism, same files, near-zero marginal cost) rather than left open.

gating_caveat._comment: Renamed cast entries (RSW_Bantha, RSW_Dewback, RSW_Vulptex, RSW_Porg) were left INSIDE their existing MayRequire="mlie.starwarsanimalcollection" PatchOperationAdd blocks rather than moved to a mandrake.rsw.swbestiary-gated block, because gen_cast_patch.py's per-animal donor gating (ANIMALPKG) is read from the newest def-dump CAPTURE, and no capture has ever seen these RSW_ defNames yet - a safe regen right now would SKIP them entirely (PAWNKINDS gate). Functionally correct today because this item's own scope keeps Mlie active until all waves land. New entries (RSW_Nuna additions, RSW_Wampa, RSW_Acklay) were gated on mandrake.rsw.swbestiary directly since there was no existing block to reuse. A full safe regen of gen_cast_patch.py, once a post-deployment capture exists, will correct every renamed entry's gating in one pass - do not hand-patch this again before then.
